warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Second text/design pass after content revision; same assistant, not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Neighbors set up a shared study table, so requests and location questions have a common purpose. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The final location question reviews Lesson 8 across intervening lessons; actual retention still needs a learner trial.

distractorQuality.evidence: A01 includes an actual handover response. A04 includes the owner/object question before its location answer and contrasts plausible referents.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Neighbors set up a shared study table, so requests and location questions have a common purpose.

difficultyFit.evidence: The final location question reviews Lesson 8 across intervening lessons; actual retention still needs a learner trial.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Audio reconstruction is labelled supported practice; the final task removes the model. A01 includes an actual handover response. A04 includes the owner/object question before its location answer and contrasts plausible referents.

transferQuality.evidence: A01 includes an actual handover response. A04 includes the owner/object question before its location answer and contrasts plausible referents. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: Neighbors set up a shared study table, so requests and location questions have a common purpose. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
